text: You have never seen your own eyes move. Not even once.
Bro, I'm looking at them right now. Left eye... right eye... wait... they just... TELEPORT?!
Your eyes jump about three times every second. And during every jump, your brain switches the picture off, so you don't see a blurry mess.
So I'm blind... three times a second?!
Tiny bits of blind. Your brain fills in the gaps. You never notice.
Okay... what ELSE is my brain hiding from me?
Your nose. It's in everything your eyes see. Your brain just edits it out.
Ugh... now I can see my nose.
Yeah. So can everyone watching this.
